subject: general
question: India and which country among the following agreed to line up a joint task force on a "proposal to construct a hydropower project" from investments of both countries in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India and Nepal** agreed to line up a joint task force on a "proposal to construct a hydropower project" from investments of both countries in February 2022.
 
• This initiative aims to enhance bilateral cooperation in the energy sector and promote sustainable hydropower development.
 
• The task force will explore potential projects, investment opportunities, and address any challenges in the implementation of such projects.
 
• This agreement further strengthens the longstanding relationship between India and Nepal, particularly in the area of energy cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India and Nepal share a long history of cooperation in the hydropower sector, with several joint projects already in operation or under development.
 
• The collaboration between the two countries in the energy sector is seen as a key driver for economic growth and development in the region.
 
• Hydropower projects are crucial for Nepal as they provide a sustainable and renewable source of energy, contributing to the country's energy security.
 
• For India, such collaborations help in meeting its growing energy demands and also strengthen regional ties.
 
• The agreement to form a joint task force signifies a commitment to work together towards mutual benefits and addressing common challenges in the hydropower sector.
